g.text: Real-time collaboration (Later) — a relay that forwards encrypted CRDT updates
Collaboration is a separate product from sync. The relay orders and stores Yjs updates it cannot read; a client writes the canonical Markdown checkpoint.
1 · Author A joins the session; the relay verifies the JWT and the per-document grant on connect.
2 · Author B joins the same document room.
3 · The connection is pinned to one relay task.
4 · Updates and presence fan out across tasks through ElastiCache pub/sub.
5 · Encrypted Yjs updates are appended in order (document, sequence); the relay cannot read them.
6 · The log is compacted into encrypted state snapshots for fast joins.
7 · Peers receive each other's updates; cursors and presence are ephemeral.
8 · The session leader periodically writes the canonical Markdown snapshot and commits it through normal encrypted sync.
